description: Search FDA Structured Product Labeling (SPL) data — full drug package inserts. Filter by drug name, manufacturer, application number, or specific label section (e.g., indications_and_usage, warnings, adverse_reactions, boxed_warning). Returns complete label text for matching sections. Related: fda_search_drugs (application-level data), fda_search_ndc (NDC product details).

drug_name.description: Brand or generic drug name (fuzzy match)

section.description: Specific label section to return (e.g. indications_and_usage, warnings, adverse_reactions)

name: fda_drug_labels
title: Search Drug Labels
